items.text: I'm trying to plan out my week and was wondering if you could help me set reminders for my upcoming fitness classes. I attend Zumba classes on Tuesdays and Thursdays at 6:30 pm, and a weightlifting class on Saturdays at 10 am.
items.why: User explicitly states they attend Zumba on Tuesdays and Thursdays and weightlifting on Saturdays.
